assessments.reasoning: AGPL [106,296) identifies the FSF copyright and gives the public both copying and distribution permission for verbatim copies. Its express restriction on changes resolves the altered-document case.

limitations: The object of the opening permission is the license document. Distribution of software requires reference to the operative provisions applicable to the form distributed.
reasoning: The FSF copyright notice at the opening of the AGPLv3 plaintext permits anyone to reproduce and distribute the license document verbatim. A complete unchanged copy of this edition fits that permission.
